name: plural-and-formatting
prompt: Localize a cart item count and total price for English, Vietnamese, and Arabic.
expectations: uses plural messages and locale-aware currency
supports RTL without manual string concatenation

name: preserves-existing-localization-tool
prompt: Add one translated onboarding screen to an app with an established gen_l10n setup.
expectations: extends existing ARB and generation configuration
does not introduce a second localization package

name: unsupported-locale-falls-back-safely
prompt: A user's phone is set to Thai but our app only supports English, Vietnamese, and Arabic. What happens?
expectations: defines explicit fallback behavior in the localization delegate or MaterialApp
does not crash or show raw message keys for unsupported locales
tests the app renders correctly with a locale outside the supported set

name: date-format-respects-locale
prompt: Display order timestamps. Use the same date format for all locales to keep the UI consistent.
expectations: rejects a single hardcoded date format across locales
uses locale-aware DateFormat for user-facing timestamps
tests that dates render correctly in representative locales including RTL
